canonical_title: Learning Domains: Cognitive, Affective and Psychomotor

one_line_answer.text: Learning domains are cognitive (knowledge), affective (attitude) and psychomotor (skills).

cites.quote: Cognitive: mental skills (Knowledge) Affective: growth in feelings or emotional areas (Attitude) Psychomotor: manual or physical skills (Skills)

bangla_explanation: শেখার তিনটা domain: Cognitive মানে knowledge, Affective মানে attitude, Psychomotor মানে skills।
Cognitive-এ facts আর concepts মনে রাখা ও বোঝা থাকে।
Affective-এ feelings, values আর motivations থাকে।
Psychomotor skills শিখতে practice লাগে, আর speed ও precision দিয়ে মাপা হয়।

example.en: A food trainer teaches recipe steps (cognitive), cleanliness attitude (affective) and knife skills (psychomotor).
example.bn: রান্নার ট্রেনিং-এ রেসিপি জানা, পরিচ্ছন্নতার মনোভাব আর ছুরি চালানোর দক্ষতা: তিনটা domain।

short.prompt: Name the three learning domains and explain each.
short.modelAnswer:
The three learning domains are:
1. Cognitive: mental skills (knowledge); recall of facts and concepts.
2. Affective: feelings, values, motivations and attitudes.
3. Psychomotor: manual or physical skills; needs practice.
